verdict.rationale: Superhuman's engineering blog says the client "works perfectly offline" and even on a terrible connection, and its search design states that search "shouldn't require a network connection to function." A hands-on user independently praises its "good offline" behavior. However, offline composing and syncing changes on reconnect are only implied by the blanket offline claim, not explicitly documented; missing for 10: explicit documentation of offline composing/sending and of how queued changes sync when you reconnect, plus hands-on detail on offline search.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can read, search, and write email offline, with changes syncing when I reconnect

citations.quote: Superhuman gives you a new way to work with Gmail. It works perfectly offline. It works even when online, and your internet connection is terrible.
Available: The search shouldn't require a network connection to function.
